Policies
Refund and Cancellation
Last updated: 10/20/2026
At Ipanema Beauty & Spa, we value your time and ours. This policy explains how cancellations, reschedules, and refunds are handled.
1. Cancellations & Reschedules
Plans change, and we understand. We kindly ask for at least 24 hours’ notice if you need to cancel or reschedule, so we can offer your time to another client.
Cancellations or reschedules with less than 24 hours’ notice may be subject to a fee. Microblading follows its own deposit policy (see section 2).
2. Microblading Deposit

Microblading is the only service that requires a deposit. A $63.75 deposit is paid at booking, online through our website or through Square. It is part of the $212.50 session price, and the remaining $148.75 is paid at the salon.
The deposit is never refunded in cash.
If you cancel or reschedule at least 48 hours in advance, the full deposit is credited to your next appointment.
Cancellations with less than 48 hours’ notice, no-shows, or arriving more than 15 minutes late forfeit the deposit.
This policy applies equally to every client.
3. No-Shows
If you can’t make it, please let us know as early as possible by phone, text or WhatsApp.
No-shows may be subject to a fee, and repeated no-shows may result in limited online booking in the future.
4. Refunds
Payments for services already rendered are non-refundable.
Refunds will only be considered in cases of proven error or unsatisfactory service, and are granted solely at the discretion of Ipanema Beauty & Spa.
5. Refunds and Cancellations
Service fees are non-refundable once the service has been completed.
Refunds are only considered in cases of proven error or unsatisfactory service, at our sole discretion.
6. Right to Refuse Refunds
We reserve the right to decline partial or full refunds if the request falls outside of this policy.
